issue_context.title: Regression: groupby_dynamic fails when crossing DST
issue_context.body:
### Polars version checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Issue description

Splitting this off from the report in https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/7418

The example below errors with
```python
PanicException: Ambiguous local time, ranging from 2021-11-07T01:00:00CDT to 2021-11-07T01:00:00CST
```

This is due to https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/7278

#7278 could be reverted, but then https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/7274 would come back.

I'll take a closer look

### Reproducible example

```python
t2 =pl.date_range(datetime(2021,11,7), datetime(2021,11,8), "1m", time_zone="UTC").dt.convert_time_zone("US/Central")
df = pl.DataFrame({"time":t2, "value": range(1441)})
df.groupby_dynamic("time", every="1h").agg(pl.col("value").mean())
```


### Expected behavior

```python
shape: (25, 2)
┌──────────────────────────┬────────┐
│ time                     ┆ value  │
│ ---                      ┆ ---    │
│ datetime[μs, US/Central] ┆ f64    │
╞══════════════════════════╪════════╡
│ 2021-11-06 19:00:00 CDT  ┆ 29.5   │
│ 2021-11-06 20:00:00 CDT  ┆ 89.5   │
│ 2021-11-06 21:00:00 CDT  ┆ 149.5  │
│ 2021-11-06 22:00:00 CDT  ┆ 209.5  │
│ ...                      ┆ ...    │
│ 2021-11-07 15:00:00 CST  ┆ 1289.5 │
│ 2021-11-07 16:00:00 CST  ┆ 1349.5 │
│ 2021-11-07 17:00:00 CST  ┆ 1409.5 │
│ 2021-11-07 18:00:00 CST  ┆ 1440.0 │
└──────────────────────────┴────────┘
```
